title: Keeping the Ball Rolling: Fullerene-like Molecular Clusters
claim: Obtaining discrete, compositionally well-defined fullerene-like clusters with metal–metal-bonded cores is difficult because their numerous reactive surface atoms favor further growth.
explanation: The review contrasts continued growth toward bulk metal with growth arrested by surface-passivating ligands, noting that arrest at a molecular cluster rather than a nanoparticle remains challenging.
scope: Fullerene-like molecular clusters with formal metal–metal-bonded cores.
conditions: Use of suitable surface-passivating ligands to terminate growth.
caveats: The proposed reason for the scarcity of these clusters is presented as a possibility, not an established universal mechanism.
